set(XEYES_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ignored-area/third-party/xeyes")

add_executable(xeyes
    ${XEYES_SRC_DIR}/xeyes.c
    ${XEYES_SRC_DIR}/Eyes.c
    ${XEYES_SRC_DIR}/transform.c
)

target_compile_definitions(xeyes PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H=1)

# Upstream sources reach for quoted "Eyes.h", "EyesP.h", "transform.h",
# "eyes.bit", "eyesmask.bit", and "config.h" -- all live in the
# third-party tree (config.h is generated by emconfigure ./configure during fetch).
target_include_directories(xeyes PRIVATE ${XEYES_SRC_DIR})

# Upstream xeyes is -Wall clean on a real toolchain but uses a handful
# of patterns our strict warnings trip on (unused fn args in
# XtActionsRec callbacks, etc.). Don't treat third-party as our own.
target_compile_options(xeyes PRIVATE -w)

# xeyes uses Xt + Xmu (for CvtStringToBackingStore) + the SHAPE stub
# (Xext) for the rounded eyes outline.
em_x11_finalize_demo(xeyes
    EXPORT_NAME createXeyesModule
    LIBS Xmu Xt Xext X11
)
